conclusion_detail: NT$8,990 is not supported for a refurbished POS or generic HMI alone. It is commercially plausible only if BenchHMI is delivered as a complete bench-automation appliance: qualified touchscreen computer + protected multi-protocol BenchIO + reproducible software/workflows + unit QA/warranty.

market_examples.interpretation: Demonstrates actual Taiwan transactions near NT$8k for a recognized 7-inch HMI.
Demonstrates actual Taiwan transactions around the proposed NT$8,990 BenchHMI price.
Shows a liquid HMI price band spanning and exceeding BenchHMI's target.
Closer use-case evidence: customers buy integrated automation/training systems rather than only bare HMI panels.
Strong warning: BenchHMI cannot justify NT$8,990 merely by providing a touchscreen PC.
Upper professional anchor only; not a claim of industrial equivalence.
Demonstrates that protected I/O itself carries meaningful value in the professional market.
Shows active local demand for CAN tooling, while also proving CAN hardware alone is too cheap to justify BenchHMI pricing.

required_at_8990: qualified touchscreen donor with known-good SSD and unit QA
at least two isolated RS-485 channels
insufficient_for_8990: USB adapters loosely bundled without integrated software/workflow

required_before_scale: at least one paid pilot or equivalent purchase commitment at or near NT$8,990
or multiple independent serious buyer interviews showing the complete bundle solves a real bench/test workflow at the target price
record which capability drove willingness to pay
record whether remanufactured donor hardware materially reduces willingness to pay
do not infer demand from competitor listings alone
commercial_validation_gate.first_offer_strategy: Test the complete BenchHMI/BenchIO appliance as one SKU. Do not test a bare refurbished-POS SKU because the market already has cheap used POS and new generic HMI/panel-PC alternatives.

boundary: Comparable product prices and marketplace sales establish price-band plausibility, not demand for BenchHMI. The NT$8,990 target remains commercially unvalidated until direct buyer evidence exists.
